origin: Derived from the capture of the gpt case of the same name, for a Claude model: Codex 0.142.5 declares the editing tool for a Claude model only when its model catalog (model_catalog_json) sets apply_patch_tool_type to freeform for that model (features.apply_patch_freeform is removed in 0.142.5 and declares nothing), and then as a custom tool: the tool is offered to the relay as a function with one patch argument; the relay's call comes back to the client as a custom tool call, and the client's answer goes back as the result of the function. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
